ينبعث (form VII)

# يُنْبَعَثُ (yunbaʕaṯu) /jun.ba.ʕa.θu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْبَعَثَ (inbaʕaṯa)
# يَنْبَعِثَ (yanbaʕiṯa) /jan.ba.ʕi.θa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَعَثَ (inbaʕaṯa)
# يُنْ
